ApiEnvelope.description: Every JSON answer of the API: success flag and a message; the payload is `data` (and `meta` for pages).

success.description:
Response schemas of the operations the CLI generates noun commands for (plan docs/plans/cli.md 6.7, S5).
Every JSON answer is the envelope `ApiEnvelope` plus `data` (and `meta` for a page); the `*Response`
schemas combine it with the resource the controller returns. Generated by hand from the controllers and
their Resource classes: when a resource changes, change its schema here.

get.description:
AG-UI events over SSE (ADR 0011). On connect: a STATE_SNAPSHOT (not stored, no id), then every
stored event after `Last-Event-ID` (or `?after=`), then new events as they are appended. The
connection closes after `course_builder.sse.max_seconds` (25 s) so PHP-FPM workers are not held;
the client reconnects with the last id. Between polls the loop watches the session's "last event"
key in the cache and only queries the table when it moved (polling fallback every 500 ms).

post.description: Redeems the `code` of a social login redirect together with the secret `verifier` whose S256 challenge started the login. The code works once, within 60 seconds, on the tenant that issued it. Call it from the front end's server, never from a page that may be logged. Returns the access token (`complete=true`) or, when the sign-up needs an e-mail address, `pre_user_token` for POST /api/auth/social/complete/{token} (`complete=false`).

400.description: The code is invalid, expired, already used or does not match the verifier

post.summary: Exchange a one-time social login code for a token

get.description: Starts a login with Google or Facebook. `return_url` must be an origin of the tenant's own apps (otherwise 422). `challenge` is the S256 challenge of a random verifier that the caller keeps secret (base64url of its SHA-256, 43 characters). After the provider's consent the browser is sent to `return_url` with a one-time `code` (60 seconds, single use) to redeem at POST /api/auth/social/exchange together with the verifier; failures arrive as `error` (provider_denied, provider_failed, link_required, email_unverified, account_unavailable).

422.description: Unknown provider, return URL not allowed or challenge missing

An access token is never put in a URL.
